title: I-MCHM: Interface Multicontinuum Homogenization for Multiscale Elliptic Problems
summary: We introduce an interface multicontinuum homogenization method (I-MCHM) for high-contrast elliptic problems whose subdomains may have distinct microscopic patterns and unequal numbers of continua. Multicontinuum models upscale microscopic fields to macroscopic continuum quantities; here the continua are the high- and low-permeability regions, and the macroscopic variables are the corresponding local averages of the fine-scale solution on observing cells of size $H_ε$.
